newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton closes steady, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton closes steady, seen stable.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed unchanged on Wednesday on a dull demand from spinners, brokers at the private Karachi Cotton Association (KCA) said.
Prices are likely to remain stable as spinners short of funds were buying small lots just to run their textile mills, one broker said.
In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was quoted for 2,075/2,225 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), the K-68 for 2,450/2,475 and the MNH-93 for 2,460/2,485, he said.
Prices are likely to open unchanged on Thursday, the broker said.
